description: Publish a session workspace as a draft GitHub PR, and manage the bound PR afterwards. Order: commit the work, push the head branch, then action=prepare, then action=publish (creates the draft PR and returns its URL). A second publish after a newer remote head merges that head in instead of overwriting it. Actions: readiness (report publishability, changes nothing), prepare (bind workspace to a PR), publish (push + create/update the draft PR), inspect (bound PR + local state), refresh_base (merge newer remote base, rebind after an identity change), edit (PR title/body), review (request reviewers), evidence (post evidence as a PR comment). Refuses with no effect on a dirty/untracked/staged/unpublished tree and while the session has running children or background processes; never force-pushes. Needs a GitHub credential (gh login or GITHUB_TOKEN) for the PR itself; the push uses the repo's own remote auth.
name: github_publish

base_branch.description: Base branch for the PR; defaults to the remote's default branch.

body.description: PR body for publish or edit.

evidence.description: Evidence text to post as a comment on the PR (evidence action).

head_branch.description: Head branch to publish; defaults to the current branch.

reviewers.description: GitHub logins to request a review from (review action).

session_id.description: Session whose workspace to publish; defaults to the current session.

title.description: PR title for publish (defaults to the head commit subject) or edit.

workspace_path.description: Explicit workspace path (a git worktree root). Defaults to the session's recorded working directory.
